$comment: Store listing fields that apify push never sends. Applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs after every deploy. Title, description and categories live in actor.json.
seoTitle: LinkedIn Profile Finder - Email to LinkedIn URL Lookup
seoDescription: Find a LinkedIn profile from an email address. Bulk email to LinkedIn lookup with a confidence score on every match. No LinkedIn login or cookies, pay per result. For sales, recruiting and CRM.
isPublic$comment: Un-deprecated 2026-09-12 after the prefill fix (builds 0.1.4 and 0.1.5). Apify refuses to unpublish a paid Actor (cannot-unpublish-paid-actor), so false here would fail the CI step until monetization is cancelled in Console.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Measured 2026-09-12 on 6 emails: 4 GB 25.3 s / 0.014 CU, 1 GB 25.0 s / 0.0069 CU, peak RSS under 100 MB. 1 GB halves compute at the same speed. actor.json caps memory at 2 GB.

pricing.$comment: Applied 2026-09-12 via API (an increase; the CI script refuses increases by design and only reconciles decreases). Market check the same day: email to LinkedIn actors on the Store charge $0.01 to $0.025 per resolved profile. Compute at 1 GB is about $0.0002 per email, so the per-email fee is value pricing, not cost recovery. Event names must match the Actor.charge() calls in harvester/actor.py. Store discounts (owner's Gentle ladder, rolled out 2026-10-29 after holehe and social-analyzer): Free and Starter keep the flat price, Scale pays 10% less, Business and above 20% less; apify-actor-start stays flat. Aug-Oct paid revenue of this actor came almost all from Starter, and Apify bills our platform cost of Scale and Business runs lower only when discounts are on (compute $0.16 and $0.13 per CU instead of $0.20, https://docs.apify.com/actors/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md). The CI script applies first-time pricing and decreases; increases go through Console with 14 days' notice.

actor_start.eventDescription: Charged once per run. Covers container start and batch setup.

email_processed.eventDescription: Charged once per email looked up, found or not. Covers the public-profile checks (GitHub, Gravatar, PGP keyservers, handle probes on 8 platforms) that recover the name and handle.

profile_found.eventDescription: Charged only when a LinkedIn URL clears your confidence gate (80% by default). Possible matches below the gate are returned free, with their score.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: Store discounts: Scale plans pay 10% less and Business and enterprise plans 20% less. Free and Starter prices are unchanged.
